categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and land registration particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land title settlement and property registration processes, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
